policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Lincoln's win over Quincy on Sunday drew them level with Drury at the head of the table, with a match in hand. They are still the only side in the conference without a defeat, nine wins and four draws in all, and the two leaders meet at Drury on Saturday.
Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.
Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made sixty-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty, a save percentage of .697.

claims.text: Southwest Baptist's forty-two goals are more than Lewis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have scored between them, and they have conceded thirty doing it; the goals have not bought a place near the top of the table.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Every side but Lincoln has now lost, and Lincoln still have Missouri S&T, Drury and McKendree to play.
